confirmed_local.finding: Public generate_content uploads each file then sends attachment reference [[upload_ref], filename]. The generation attachment descriptor omits explicit MIME and media-kind enumeration.
Multipart MIME comes from mimetypes.guess_type(filename); body bytes are sent unchanged, then response.text is returned after HTTP success. There is no file-readiness observation.
Validated audio/webm is privately named 0.weba only for Web to ensure SDK multipart audio/webm. WAV uses .wav; audio/ogg uses .ogg. No transcoding.
Canary explicitly requests a complete transcript inside JSON text with proper JSON escaping; expected phrase/hash is absent from the model prompt.
HTTP200 upload and EOF; 18 candidates; final text already invalid after _parse_candidate, identical after Candidate. HTML unescape compensation did not cause that failure.
Completed JSON response with audio/file/format keywords, 253 answer characters, no exact transcript match. No timeout or evidence of universal format incompatibility.

primary_sources.finding: Current Gemini Apps Help supports audio uploads generally, but does not enumerate WebM/Ogg codecs. API audio format documentation cannot certify Web session ingestion.
Closed unmerged proposal used explicit MIME and media-kind metadata in multimedia references. Author tested the old upload endpoint successfully too; this does not prove a mandatory endpoint change.
Proposed descriptor [[upload_ref,file_code,None,mime_type],filename], with audio code4. This is a historical proposal, not an approved current Google protocol contract.
Maintainer rejected audio support in February2025, describing then-Web microphone STT. Too old and different from uploaded files to certify current unsupported status.
Author reproduces intermittent attachment failures after successful uploads. Different larger code attachments; cannot attribute this account or codec failures.
Another implementation fixed garbled binary interpretation by preserving multipart MIME and reference filename. Nodia already preserves both; useful diagnostic pattern, not the same confirmed defect.

hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: WebM/Ogg may reach an incorrect file-ingestion classification despite correct multipart MIME; generation reference has only URL and filename.
hypotheses_ranked.minimal_test: Observe official Web request metadata for a synthetic file and compare descriptor/MIME/filename shape, never cookies or content. Do not copy historical code4 blindly.

hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Web filename .weba may be less recognized by the provider than .webm even with audio/webm MIME.
hypotheses_ranked.minimal_test: After obtaining current reference evidence, compare same original bytes and explicit audio/webm with filename variants; one controlled variable, no fallback or global MIME mutation.

hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Ogg final JSON is already malformed in the actual provider candidate or is changed by SDK pre-Candidate cleanup.
hypotheses_ranked.minimal_test: Add content-free pre-_parse_candidate source fingerprints and closed lexical/format flags; compare chosen candidate across raw-source, post-cleaning and Candidate. Preserve strict rejection.

hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Current Web model/session may handle PCM but fail or refuse Opus ingestion.
hypotheses_ranked.minimal_test: Keep original formats, model and session fixed. Exact-format canaries and safe refusal keywords determine behavior; do not infer support from model names or Web Help generality.

recommendation: Instrument raw candidate boundary first; do not rewrite upload or transcode without an observed current protocol mismatch. Preserve MIME-exact admission, 120s deadline, one generation per explicit canary, and reconciliation before any next attempt.
